test_title: PYST 45: SSC GD Constable 2022 - English (Held On : 31 Jan 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.**

**__Between the 11 members of the team__**, there was great discord and this led to their dismal performance.

options.text: Between the 11 member off the team
Among the 11 members of the team
Between the 11 members in the team
Beside the 11 members of the team

solution:
The correct answer is **"Among the 11 members of the team."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Between"** is used when there are only two things or people being compared.

 
 
• **Example**:* There is no comparison **between**__ Rahul and Riya.*
 
 
 
• In this case, there are 11 members, so we need to use **"among"** instead.
 
• **"Among"** is used when there are three or more things or people being compared.
 __
 
• **Example**: *There is no comparison among__ them.*
 
 
 
• Using **"between"** in this sentence is grammatically incorrect.
 
• The word **"off"** is not necessary and would make the sentence incorrect if used.
 
• **"Beside"** means next to or alongside, so it does not make sense in this context.
 
• The correct answer is Option 2.

**Correct sentence**: *__**Among the 11 members of the team**__, there was great discord and this led to their dismal performance.*
